changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.37
- Host pulse buttons now glow when engaged, so you can see which ports you have active for the group.
- New "Host Hotkeys" section in Keybinds: bind keys to pulse Session 3074 / 27k / 30k / 7500 / Reconnect to everyone you control.
- Controlled players are now fully locked out of their own limiter (all their module hotkeys are disabled while the host controls them).
- The host clicks members in the roster to choose who to control; controlled players are highlighted, and pulses only affect them.
